title: criteria evidence layers (criterion_evidence, criterion_prove_red) are dormant fleet-wide because kind:/prove_red: are opt-in and never declared — criteria are trusted on exit-code alone
detail: Fleet dashboard: criterion_evidence and criterion_prove_red never fired across all adopters. Cause is NOT that criteria aren't written (they are, heavily) — it is that kind: and prove_red: are OPT-IN and no criterion declares them. So a local verify_command is trusted on exit code alone: a vacuous verify (exit 0, nothing executed) passes, and an acceptance test that was never RED proves nothing (vacuous-green). Two fixes, fb-c76 philosophy (make evidence the default, not a flag): (a) INFER kind from a test/lint/type-shaped verify_command (pytest/vitest/mypy/tsc/ruff/eslint) so execution-evidence arms automatically — bare tsc augmented with --extendedDiagnostics so a silent-clean typecheck still emits its count; npm/pnpm wrappers NOT inferred (opaque). (b) A deterministic brief-lint advisory that flags a new_feature brief whose local acceptance criteria lack prove_red, nudging a RED-baseline capture so the acceptance test is load-bearing. charter_freshness is NOT part of this — it is a benign preventive advisory that correctly hasn't fired (charters fresh).
repro: fleet dashboard ceremony-watch: criterion_evidence 0/0, criterion_prove_red 0/0; 0 criteria declare kind:/prove_red: across the fleet
